details.description: Branching recessed lava seams descend the tall far volcanic peak and split into smaller tributaries.
details.affects: far-horizon peak silhouette and emissive depth

details.description: Uneven horizontal and diagonal basalt terrace ridges step toward the glowing ravines.
details.affects: far terrain depth and grazing highlights

details.description: A pointed iron teardrop frame surrounds a real open flame aperture with a thick beveled collar.
Narrow vertical tower piers carry real chamfered edges that catch orange grazing light above deep recesses.
details.affects: central tower verticality and material separation

details.description: Cooled black crust forms irregular raised lips and downward teeth around hot molten overhangs.
The side brazier uses a low circular bowl ringed by short black iron spikes and a bright central flame.
Sparse embers vary in size and value across near, middle, and far smoke layers rather than forming a uniform field.
Front-left cliff columns break into nonuniform vertical facets with missing corners along the silhouette.
Heavy oval iron chain links hang vertically from the outer cliff with visible interlocking rotation and irregular soot.
A rare cool cyan circular beacon sits inside a brass-rimmed stone socket, balancing the dominant orange palette.
details.affects: cool accent hierarchy and side-platform identity

details.description: Connected low labyrinth walls have thick cap blocks with recessed joints, chipped corners, and orange cavity spill.
details.affects: citadel maze hierarchy and phone readability

details.description: Tall amber window slits are deep openings behind narrow iron/stone frames, not flat orange decals.
details.affects: tower depth and emissive scale hierarchy

details.description: Molten channels have narrow cooled crust borders that vary in width and expose brighter yellow cores at constrictions.
Front radial stairs use thick treads with chipped beveled noses, dark risers, and orange contact light.
Small aged-brass studs repeat along the route rim at regular spacing with brighter crowns and darker recesses.
details.affects: route material identity without replacing canonical tiles

details.description: A broad orange lavafall drops from a visible channel mouth down a deeply faceted lateral cliff and narrows between rock ribs.
The dark orange egg carries irregular bright molten cracks separated by raised cooled shell islands.
The major front lavafall uses a yellow-orange central hot core, darker red margins, and black cooled ledges interrupting the flow.
details.affects: front focal hierarchy and floating-island depth

details.description: Black soot and warm brown patina concentrate in masonry cavities, under iron collars, and around flame-adjacent recesses.
Aged orange-gold trim shows bright edge wear on raised rims and darker brown patina in recessed seams near braziers and banners.
